*Two new industry awards recognize Powerfleet's ability to connect safety, assets and operational intelligence across the entire customer enterprise.*


WOODCLIFF LAKE, N.J.


, Sept. 30, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Powerfleet, Inc. (Nasdaq: AIOT) (JSE: PWR), a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry, today announced that its Unity AIoT platform and connected safety technology have received two honors in the 2026 Logistics, Warehouse & Supply Chain Awards: AIoT Technology Innovation Award 2026 and Most Innovative On-Site Safety Technology Provider 2026, awarded by Corporate Vision.


The two awards recognize complementary strengths of Powerfleet's technology: Unity's ability to connect operational data across complex enterprise environments, and Powerfleet's use of that connected intelligence to improve on-site safety.


Steve Towe, CEO of Powerfleet, said: "Customers increasingly want to manage their operations as one connected environment, not as a collection of separate fleets, sites and systems. That is exactly what Unity is built to enable.


"Unity connects data across the warehouse, yard and road, giving customers one operational view across their people, vehicles and assets. These awards acknowledge both the value of bringing those environments together and the impact that connected intelligence can have on operational safety and performance."


Unity received the AIoT Technology Innovation Award 2026 for bringing together data from workers, equipment, assets and vehicles across warehouses, factories, yards and the road.


Powerfleet was also named Most Innovative On-Site Safety Technology Provider 2026 for its connected approach to workplace safety. Technologies such as AI forklift pedestrian safety video help address critical risk. When that data is connected with wider operational data in Unity, customers can also identify recurring exposure, understand patterns of risk and take action to improve how their operations are designed and managed.


Corporate Vision's Logistics, Warehouse & Supply Chain Awards are determined through an independent, merit-based research and evaluation process, with nominees assessed on areas including innovation, customer operational efficiency outcomes, service quality, scalability and sustainability practices.


**ABOUT POWERFLEET**


Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry. Powerfleet unifies business operations through the ingestion, harmonization, and integration of data, irrespective of source, and delivers actionable insights to help companies save lives, time, and money. Powerfleet's ethos transcends our data ecosystem and commitment to innovation; our people-centric approach empowers our customers to realize impactful and sustained business improvement. The Company is headquartered in New Jersey, United States, with offices around the globe.
